name: Shipment Reliability
description: Compare delivery promises with actual arrivals across regional carrier lanes.
grain: One row per delivery week, region and carrier
lineage_note: The remediated dispatch feed is also used by Finance.
metric_definition: Delivered shipments on or before the promised date divided by all delivered shipments. Pending shipments are outside the denominator.
purpose: Prioritise carrier reviews using a common definition of a late shipment.
retention: Keep accepted snapshots for the demo session. Target: 90 days of raw data and 13 months of aggregates.

name: Freight Spend
description: Reconcile booked freight costs by accounting month, region and carrier.
grain: One row per dispatch month, region and carrier
lineage_note: Shares Dispatch events and the standard Silver model with Shipment Reliability.
metric_definition: Sum of freight cost in integer EUR cents, grouped by dispatch month. Taxes and return transport are outside this dataset.
purpose: Compare lane costs and explain movements in the monthly cost review.
retention: Keep accepted snapshots for the demo session. Target: 90 days of raw data and 25 months of aggregates.

name: Returns Pulse
description: Spot changes in return volume and refund exposure by channel and reason.
grain: One row per return week, channel and reason
lineage_note: Only aggregated reasons and channels reach consumers.
metric_definition: Count of unique return requests opened in the week. It is a volume measure without a sales denominator.
purpose: Help product teams choose which preventable return reasons to investigate.
retention: Keep accepted snapshots for the demo session. Target: 30 days of raw data and 13 months of aggregates.
